decision: 5 second time penalty. (5 seconds added to elapsed Race time).
fact: Car 12 was released in an unsafe manner into the path of Car 43.
offence: Breach of Article B1.6.2a of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 12 (Kimi Antonelli), team representative and reviewed video and in-car video evidence and determined that Car 12 was released in an unsafe manner when Car 43 was approaching in the fast lane. While Car 12 was entitled to travel down the pit lane in parallel to cars in the fast lane, in this instance, Car 12 momentarily lost control on the slippery surface and had to take steps to avoid a collision and that resulted in a potentially unsafe situation. The team acknowledged that this release could have been handled better and in a safer manner. We impose a 5 second time penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 12 Unsafe Release
